statusNote: Experimental. Programs run on the lab's own model of the board, not on the board's real software. No display, DHT sensor, servo or Wi-Fi yet. Nothing has been checked against a real board.

summary.en: The default board of the projects and the school kit.

simplified: Programs run against the lab's own board library: the code a student writes runs exactly, and what the board does in answer is a model.
Code takes no time to run; each library call is charged two microseconds.
An interrupt is delivered up to a millisecond after its edge.
A PWM output faster than 2 kHz is shown switching at 2 kHz, with its duty kept.
The analog converter is a nominal chip from Espressif's calibration curve; real chips differ by several percent.
Pins are sources with a fixed output resistance; no brown-out, no noise, no damage from 5 V.
